items.text: Model Question and Answer Revision Sheet
Q1. Who is called the Father of the Indian Renaissance? Answer: Raja Ram Mohan Roy is called the Father of the Indian Renaissance.
Q2. Which organisation did Jyotirao Phule found in 1873? Answer: Jyotirao Phule founded the Satyashodhak Samaj in 1873.
Q3. What is transpiration in plants? Answer: Transpiration is the loss of water vapour from plant leaves.
Q4. Where was the first cotton textile mill set up in 1854? Answer: The first cotton textile mill was set up at Mumbai in 1854.
Q5. Which river is Cuttack situated on? Answer: Cuttack is situated on the River Mahanadi.
Q6. What is the minimum age for a member of the Lok Sabha? Answer: A member must be at least 25 years old.
